atoms.title: Malware types (viruses, worms, trojans, ransomware)
atoms.objective: Identify the four major malware categories, viruses, worms, trojans, and ransomware, describe how each spreads and causes harm, and classify a described infection by its behavioral signature.

atoms.title: Device tampering and physical compromise
atoms.objective: Identify physical security threats (including hardware keyloggers, malicious USB drop attacks, and unauthorized physical access), explain how physical compromise bypasses logical network defenses, and analyze...

atoms.title: IoT device vulnerabilities
atoms.objective: Explain why Internet of Things (IoT) devices carry unusually high risk, identify the specific vulnerability categories that make them easy targets, and classify a described smart device by its dominant weakness.
